headline: “The real private tutoring market could exceed 1 billion euros”. Parents draw attention to deficient controls
summary: Only 5% of pre-university teachers declared private tutoring income to ANAF in 2025. The number of declaring teachers fell from 12,772 to 12,503 year on year.
why: ANAF is Romania's national tax authority, and gaps in income declarations relate to tax collection and the size of the informal economy.
